memory-review.json.assessment: Reviewed all36groups and both observations per group. All9 large-owner/once groups reduce mean peak RSS by20.40–20.76percent, roughly10MB per process. Small cases have mixed signs; the largest small mean increase is increment_return/8/retained/JIT +75776bytes/+0.986percent, with +167936/-16384byte observations. Retained large cases also have mixed signs: largest mean increase is read_only/32768/retained/JIT +438272bytes/+0.626percent, positive in both rounds (+524288/+352256). Largest individual increase is write_only/32768/retained/JIT +1200128bytes, paired with -716800bytes in the other round (mean+241664bytes/+0.346percent). These increases remain observed tradeoffs; their cause is not established and they are not dismissed as noise. Accept this bounded admission change: all snapshot/semantic controls pass, all576 allocation totals/slopes are non-regressing in covered cases, no new frame/cache representation is introduced, and large once-snapshot RSS improves consistently across all counter types/runtimes. Two local samples do not establish universal memory neutrality, leak freedom, retained-heap bounds, production behavior or competitive speed.

from owner import snapshot, edit
let original := snapshot()
mut n := 1
while n <= 16 {
  assert_equal(edit(n), n)
  assert_equal(snapshot()[0], n + 1)
  assert_equal(snapshot()[1], n)
  n += 1
}
assert_equal(original[0], 0)
assert_equal(original[1], 0)

print("OPERATOR ESCAPE PASS")

require 'json';require 'digest';require 'open3';require 'fileutils'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);base=File.expand_path('../array-batch-v2-2026-10-29',o);fixtures=File.expand_path('../array-batch-baseline-2026-10-29',o)
raise 'Invalid baseline' unless system('ruby','benchmarks/langarena/probes/verify-array-batch-isolation.rb',fixtures)
prior=JSON.parse(File.read(fixtures+'/report.json'));out=o+'/batch-controls';raise 'Output exists' if File.exist?(out);FileUtils.mkdir_p(out)
probes={'baseline'=>base+'/task-allocation-probe','candidate'=>o+'/task-allocation-probe'};binary=o+'/candidate-kujo'
r={status:'running',pid:Process.pid,identities:(probes.values+[binary,__FILE__]).to_h{|p|[p,Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest]},baseline_report_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(fixtures+'/report.json').hexdigest,sources:prior['sources'],rows:[],semantics:[]}
save=->{File.write(out+'/report.json',JSON.pretty_generate(r)+"\n")};save.call
begin
 prior['semantics'].select{|x|x['mode']=='vm'}.each do |old|
  path=old['argv'][2];owner=File.dirname(path)+'/owner.kujo'
  raise 'Fixture changed' unless Digest::SHA256.file(path).hexdigest==old['source_sha256']&&Digest::SHA256.file(owner).hexdigest==old['module_sha256']
  meta=old.reject{|k,v|%w[mode argv exit].include?(k)}
  %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
   args=[binary,'run',path,'--untrusted','--scheduler-no-timeout'];args<<'--'+mode unless mode=='vm'
   stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args);raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="ARRAY BATCH PASS\n"
   r[:semantics]<<meta.merge(mode:mode,argv:args,exit:status.exitstatus)
  end
  %w[vm jit].each do |mode|
   row=meta.merge(mode:mode)
   probes.each do |kind,probe|
    args=[probe,mode,path];stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args);raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="ARRAY BATCH PASS\n"
    m=stderr.match(/ALLOCATION_AUDIT requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/);raise stderr unless m
    row[kind]={argv:args,requests:m[1].to_i,bytes:m[2].to_i}
   end
   r[:rows]<<row
  end
  save.call
 end
 raise 'Coverage' unless r[:rows].size==288&&r[:semantics].size==432
 r[:identities].each{|p,h|raise 'Identity drift' unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==h}
 r[:status]='characterized';save.call
rescue=>e;r[:status]='failed';r[:error]=e.message;save.call;raise
end

require 'json';require 'digest';require 'fileutils';require 'open3'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);out=o+'/cold-controls';raise 'Output exists' if File.exist?(out);FileUtils.mkdir_p(out)
base=File.expand_path('../array-batch-v2-2026-10-29',o);probes={'baseline'=>base+'/task-allocation-probe','candidate'=>o+'/task-allocation-probe'};binary=o+'/candidate-kujo'
r={status:'running',pid:Process.pid,runner_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(__FILE__).hexdigest,identities:(probes.values+[binary]).to_h{|p|[p,Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest]},sources:{},rows:[],semantics:[]};save=->{File.write(out+'/report.json',JSON.pretty_generate(r)+"\n")};save.call
begin
 %w[parameter read_only write_only increment_return].product([8,2048],[1,2],%w[once fresh]).each do |counter,width,calls,snapshot|
  d=out+'/'+[counter,width,calls,snapshot].join('-');FileUtils.mkdir_p(d)
  update={'parameter'=>'','read_only'=>'','write_only'=>'counter = n','increment_return'=>'counter += 1'}.fetch(counter)
  result=%w[read_only increment_return].include?(counter) ? 'counter' : 'n'
  owner="mut state := {} mut k := 0 while k < #{width} { state[k] = 0 k += 1 }\nmut counter := 0\nexport func snapshot() { return state }\nexport func counter_value() { return counter }\nexport func edit(n) { #{update} mut j := 0 while j < 8 { state[j] = n j += 1 } return #{result} }\n"
  source="from owner import snapshot, counter_value, edit\nlet original := snapshot()\nmut i := 0 while i < #{calls} { #{snapshot=='fresh' ? 'let saved := snapshot()' : ''} assert_equal(edit(i + 1), #{counter=='read_only' ? '0' : 'i + 1'}) #{snapshot=='fresh' ? 'mut j := 0 while j < 8 { assert_equal(saved[j], i) j += 1 }' : ''} i += 1 }\nlet final := snapshot()\nassert_equal(counter_value(), #{%w[write_only increment_return].include?(counter) ? calls : 0})\nassert_equal(len(final), #{width}) mut k := 0 while k < #{width} { assert_equal(original[k], 0) if k < 8 { assert_equal(final[k], #{calls}) } else { assert_equal(final[k], 0) } k += 1 }\nprint(\"CAPTURE COLD PASS\")\n"
  File.write(d+'/owner.kujo',owner);File.write(d+'/main.kujo',source);[d+'/owner.kujo',d+'/main.kujo'].each{|p|r[:sources][p]=Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest}
  meta={counter:counter,width:width,calls:calls,snapshot:snapshot,path:d+'/main.kujo'}
  %w[vm jit].each do |mode|
   row=meta.merge(mode:mode)
   probes.each do |kind,probe|
    args=[probe,mode,meta[:path]];stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args);m=stderr.match(/ALLOCATION_AUDIT requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/)
    raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="CAPTURE COLD PASS\n"&&m
    row[kind]={argv:args,stdout:stdout,stderr:stderr,exit:status.exitstatus,requests:m[1].to_i,bytes:m[2].to_i}
   end
   r[:rows]<<row;save.call
  end
  %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
   args=[binary,'run',meta[:path],'--untrusted'];args<<'--'+mode unless mode=='vm';stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args)
   raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="CAPTURE COLD PASS\n"
   r[:semantics]<<meta.merge(mode:mode,argv:args,stdout:stdout,stderr:stderr,exit:status.exitstatus);save.call
  end
 end

o=File.expand_path(__dir__);raise 'Final queue exists' if File.exist?(o+'/final-gate-state.json')
s={status:'running',pid:Process.pid,stage:'waiting-continuation'};save=->{File.write(o+'/final-gate-state.json',JSON.pretty_generate(s)+"\n")};save.call
run=->(stage,args){s[:stage]=stage;save.call;File.write(o+'/'+stage+'-argv.json',JSON.pretty_generate(args)+"\n");raise stage unless system(*args,out:o+'/'+stage+'.log',err:[:child,:out])}
begin
 loop do
  state=JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/continuation-state.json'));break if state['status']=='review-pending';raise 'Earlier continuation failed' if state['status']=='failed';Process.kill(0,state['pid']);sleep 5
 end
 run.call('final-source',['ruby',o+'/verify-source.rb'])
 run.call('cold',['ruby',o+'/cold-controls.rb'])
 run.call('cold-verification',['ruby',o+'/verify-cold.rb'])
 run.call('checksums',['ruby',o+'/verify-checksums.rb'])
 run.call('format',['cargo','fmt','--check'])
 run.call('diff',['git','diff','--check'])
 run.call('broad-verification',['ruby',o+'/verify-broad.rb'])
 run.call('memory',['ruby',o+'/memory-controls.rb'])
 run.call('memory-verification',['ruby',o+'/verify-memory.rb'])
 run.call('final-source-after-memory',['ruby',o+'/verify-source.rb'])
 s[:status]='review-pending';s[:stage]='manual-memory-review-and-acceptance-required';save.call
rescue=>e;s[:status]='failed';s[:error]=e.message;save.call;raise
end

memory-controls.rb.text:
require 'json';require 'digest';require 'open3';require 'fileutils'
smoke=ARGV==['--smoke'];raise 'Unexpected arguments' unless ARGV.empty?||smoke
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);out=o+(smoke ? '/memory-smoke' : '/memory-controls');raise 'Output exists' if File.exist?(out);FileUtils.mkdir_p(out)
bins={'baseline'=>File.expand_path('../array-batch-v2-2026-10-29/candidate-kujo',o),'candidate'=>(smoke ? File.expand_path('../array-batch-v2-2026-10-29/candidate-kujo',o) : o+'/candidate-kujo')}
r={status:'running',pid:Process.pid,runner_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(__FILE__).hexdigest,identities:bins.transform_values{|p|Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest},sources:{},rows:[],limits:'Two local observations; peak process RSS is not retained heap, leak proof or clean-host performance.'};save=->{File.write(out+'/report.json',JSON.pretty_generate(r)+"\n")};save.call
begin
 %w[read_only write_only increment_return].product(smoke ? [8] : [8,32768],smoke ? ['retained'] : %w[once retained]).each do |counter,width,snapshot|
  d=out+'/'+[counter,width,snapshot].join('-');FileUtils.mkdir_p(d)
  update={'read_only'=>'','write_only'=>'counter = n','increment_return'=>'counter += 1'}.fetch(counter)
  owner="mut state := {} mut k := 0 while k < #{width} { state[k] = 0 k += 1 }\nmut counter := 0\nexport func snapshot() { return state }\nexport func counter_value() { return counter }\nexport func edit(n) { #{update} mut j := 0 while j < 8 { state[j] = n j += 1 } return counter }\n"
  validate=->(obj,value){"if true { assert_equal(len(#{obj}), #{width}) mut k := 0 while k < #{width} { if k < 8 { assert_equal(#{obj}[k], #{value}) } else { assert_equal(#{obj}[k], 0) } k += 1 } }\n"}
  source="from owner import snapshot, counter_value, edit\nlet original := snapshot()\nmut saved := [] mut i := 0 while i < 4 { #{snapshot=='retained' ? 'saved = push(saved, snapshot())' : ''} assert_equal(edit(i + 1), #{counter=='read_only' ? '0' : 'i + 1'}) i += 1 }\nlet final := snapshot()\nassert_equal(counter_value(), #{counter=='read_only' ? 0 : 4})\n#{validate.call('original','0')}#{validate.call('final','4')}"
  source+="i = 0 while i < 4 { #{validate.call('saved[i]','i')} i += 1 }\n" if snapshot=='retained'
  source+="print(\"CAPTURE MEMORY PASS\")\n"
  File.write(d+'/owner.kujo',owner);File.write(d+'/main.kujo',source);[d+'/owner.kujo',d+'/main.kujo'].each{|p|r[:sources][p]=Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest}
  %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
   (smoke ? 1 : 2).times do |round|
    row={counter:counter,width:width,snapshot:snapshot,calls:4,mode:mode,round:round,path:d+'/main.kujo'}
    (round.even? ? %w[baseline candidate] : %w[candidate baseline]).each do |kind|
     r[:stage]=[counter,width,snapshot,mode,round,kind].join('/');save.call
     args=['/usr/bin/time','-l',bins[kind],'run',row[:path],'--untrusted'];args<<'--'+mode unless mode=='vm'
     stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args);rss=stderr.match(/(\d+)\s+maximum resident set size/)
     raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="CAPTURE MEMORY PASS\n"&&rss
     row[kind]={argv:args,stdout:stdout,stderr:stderr,exit:status.exitstatus,rss_bytes:rss[1].to_i}
    end
    r[:rows]<<row;save.call
   end
  end
 end
 raise 'Coverage' unless r[:rows].size==(smoke ? 9 : 72)
 bins.each{|k,p|raise 'Binary drift' unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==r[:identities][k]};r[:sources].each{|p,h|raise 'Source drift' unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==h}
 r[:status]='characterized';save.call;puts(smoke ? '9 baseline memory fixture smoke pairs passed' : '72 memory pairs characterized; manual review required')
rescue=>e;r[:status]='failed';r[:error]=e.message;save.call;raise
end

run-matrix.rb.text:
require 'json';require 'digest';require 'open3'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__)
label,bin,probe=ARGV;raise 'Expected label binary probe' unless ARGV.size==3
bin,probe=[bin,probe].map{|p|File.expand_path(p)}
output=o+'/'+label+'-matrix.json';raise 'Output exists' if File.exist?(output)
prior=File.expand_path('../compound-capture-e445-2026-10-29',o)
reference=JSON.parse(File.read(prior+'/report.json'))
r={status:'running',pid:Process.pid,binary:bin,binary_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(bin).hexdigest,probe:probe,probe_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(probe).hexdigest,runner_sha256:Digest::SHA256.file(__FILE__).hexdigest,sources:{},rows:[],semantics:[]}
save=->{File.write(output,JSON.pretty_generate(r)+"\n")};save.call
begin
 cases=reference['rows'].map{|x|x.slice('operation','counter','width','snapshot','calls','source_sha256','module_sha256')}.uniq
 raise 'Case set' unless cases.length==64
 cases.each do |meta|
  path=prior+'/'+meta.values_at('operation','counter','width','snapshot','calls').join('-')+'/main.kujo'
  {'source_sha256'=>path,'module_sha256'=>File.dirname(path)+'/owner.kujo'}.each{|key,p|h=Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest;raise 'Fixture drift' unless h==meta[key];r[:sources][p]=h}
  r[:stage]=path;save.call
  %w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
   args=[bin,'run',path,'--untrusted','--scheduler-no-timeout'];args<<'--'+mode unless mode=='vm'
   stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args)
   raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="COMPOUND CAPTURE PASS\n"
   r[:semantics]<<meta.merge(mode:mode,argv:args,stdout:stdout,stderr:stderr,exit:status.exitstatus);save.call
  end
  %w[vm jit].each do |mode|
   args=[probe,mode,path];stdout,stderr,status=Open3.capture3(*args);counts=stderr.match(/ALLOCATION_AUDIT requests=(\d+) requested_bytes=(\d+)/)
   raise stdout+stderr unless status.success?&&stdout=="COMPOUND CAPTURE PASS\n"&&counts
   r[:rows]<<meta.merge(mode:mode,argv:args,stdout:stdout,stderr:stderr,exit:status.exitstatus,requests:counts[1].to_i,bytes:counts[2].to_i);save.call
  end
 end
 raise 'Coverage' unless r[:rows].length==128&&r[:semantics].length==192
 r[:slopes]=r[:rows].group_by{|x|x.values_at('operation','counter','width','snapshot',:mode)}.map do |group,rows|
  a,b=rows.sort_by{|x|x['calls']};{group:group,requests:(b[:requests]-a[:requests]).fdiv(b['calls']-a['calls']),bytes:(b[:bytes]-a[:bytes]).fdiv(b['calls']-a['calls'])}
 end
 raise 'Binary drift' unless Digest::SHA256.file(bin).hexdigest==r[:binary_sha256]&&Digest::SHA256.file(probe).hexdigest==r[:probe_sha256]
 r[:status]='characterized';save.call
 puts label+':128 allocation observations/192 semantic cases completed'
rescue=>e;r[:status]='failed';r[:error]=e.message;save.call;raise
end

o=File.expand_path(__dir__);read=->(p){JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/'+p))};sha=->(p){Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest}
raise 'Gates incomplete' unless read.call('final-gate-state.json')['status']=='review-pending'
commands=[['verify-source.rb'],['verify-matrix.rb','baseline'],['verify-matrix.rb','candidate'],['verify-cold.rb'],['verify-batch.rb'],['verify-fallback.rb','fallback-controls'],['verify-boundary.rb','boundary-controls'],['verify-operator-controls.rb','operator-controls'],['verify-dense.rb','dense-controls'],['verify-compound-contracts.rb'],['verify-broad.rb'],['verify-memory.rb']]
commands.each_with_index{|args,i|raise args.first unless system('ruby',o+'/'+args.first,*args.drop(1),out:o+"/acceptance-#{i}.log",err:[:child,:out])}
raise 'Target coverage' unless read.call('candidate-verified.json').values_at('status','allocations','semantics')==['passed',128,192]
raise 'Cold coverage' unless read.call('cold-verified.json').values_at('status','pairs','semantics')==['passed',64,96]
raise 'Batch coverage' unless read.call('batch-verified.json').values_at('status','pairs','semantics')==['passed',288,432]
base=File.expand_path('../array-batch-v2-2026-10-29/task-allocation-probe',o);ids=[base,o+'/task-allocation-probe',o+'/candidate-kujo'].to_h{|p|[p,sha.call(p)]}
{'fallback'=>16,'boundary'=>16,'operator'=>16,'dense'=>48}.each do |kind,n|
 r=read.call(kind+'-controls/report.json');raise 'Control identity/coverage' unless r['status']=='passed'&&r['identities']==ids&&r['rows'].size==n&&r['semantics'].size==n*3/2&&r['semantics'].all?{|x|x['exit']==0}
end
b=read.call('broad-verification.json');raise 'Broad coverage' unless b.values_at('status','library_passes','library_ignored','integration_passes','integration_ignored','test_size_checksums')==['passed',1262,8,412,1,150]
c=read.call('compound-contracts.json');raise 'Compound coverage' unless c['status']=='passed'&&c['rows'].size==15
m=read.call('memory-verification.json');review=read.call('memory-review.json')
raise 'Memory coverage' unless m['pairs']==72&&m['groups'].size==36
raise 'Memory review missing/stale' unless review['status']=='reviewed'&&review['decision']=='accept'&&review['verification_sha256']==sha.call(o+'/memory-verification.json')&&review['all_groups_reviewed']==m['groups']&&review['assessment'].is_a?(String)&&!review['assessment'].empty?
raise 'Format' unless system('cargo','fmt','--check',out:o+'/acceptance-format.log',err:[:child,:out])
raise 'Diff' unless system('git','diff','--check',out:o+'/acceptance-diff.log',err:[:child,:out])

files += commands.map(&:first).uniq + %w[run-matrix.rb cold-controls.rb batch-controls.rb memory-controls.rb]
r={status:'accepted',allocation_pairs:576,semantic_checks:864,library_passes:1262,library_ignored:8,integration_passes:412,integration_ignored:1,test_size_checksums:150,additional_compound_contracts:15,memory_pairs:72,evidence_hashes:files.to_h{|p|[p,sha.call(o+'/'+p)]},verifier_sha256:sha.call(__FILE__),limits:'Captured-scalar admission only; compound indexed arithmetic, broader capture materialization and representation work remain open. No production-size or clean-host performance claim.'}
File.write(o+'/acceptance-receipt.json',JSON.pretty_generate(r)+"\n");puts 'Captured-scalar acceptance verified; commit/export still required'

verify-batch.rb.text:
require 'json';require 'digest'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);r=JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/batch-controls/report.json'));raise 'Incomplete' unless r['status']=='characterized'
sha=->(p){Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest};base=File.expand_path('../array-batch-v2-2026-10-29',o);fixtures=File.expand_path('../array-batch-baseline-2026-10-29',o)
probes={'baseline'=>base+'/task-allocation-probe','candidate'=>o+'/task-allocation-probe'};binary=o+'/candidate-kujo'
raise 'Identities' unless r['identities']==(probes.values+[binary,o+'/batch-controls.rb']).to_h{|p|[p,sha.call(p)]}
raise 'Baseline drift' unless r['baseline_report_sha256']==sha.call(fixtures+'/report.json')
keys=%w[payload writes width snapshot calls mode];cases=%w[array mixed struct].product([3,8,64],[64,2048],%w[once fresh],[1,2,16,32])
raise 'Allocation coverage' unless r['rows'].map{|x|x.values_at(*keys)}.sort==cases.product(%w[vm jit]).map{|a,b|a+[b]}.sort
raise 'Semantic coverage' unless r['semantics'].map{|x|x.values_at(*keys)}.sort==cases.product(%w[vm interpreter jit]).map{|a,b|a+[b]}.sort
r['sources'].each{|h,s|raise 'Embedded source drift' unless Digest::SHA256.hexdigest(s)==h}
(r['rows']+r['semantics']).each do |x|
 p=fixtures+'/'+x.values_at(*keys.first(5)).join('-')+'/main.kujo'
 raise 'Fixture drift' unless sha.call(p)==x['source_sha256']&&sha.call(File.dirname(p)+'/owner.kujo')==x['module_sha256']
 if x.key?('exit')
  args=[binary,'run',p,'--untrusted','--scheduler-no-timeout'];args<<'--'+x['mode'] unless x['mode']=='vm'
  raise 'Semantic execution' unless x['exit']==0&&x['argv']==args
 else
  probes.each{|k,probe|raise 'Probe command' unless x[k]['argv']==[probe,x['mode'],p]}
 end
end
regressions=r['rows'].select{|x|%w[requests bytes].any?{|k|x['candidate'][k]>x['baseline'][k]}}
slopes=r['rows'].group_by{|x|x.values_at('payload','writes','width','snapshot','mode')}.flat_map do |g,rows|
 rows.sort_by{|x|x['calls']}.each_slice(2).map{|a,b|{group:g,calls:[a['calls'],b['calls']],baseline:%w[requests bytes].to_h{|k|[k,(b['baseline'][k]-a['baseline'][k]).fdiv(b['calls']-a['calls'])]},candidate:%w[requests bytes].to_h{|k|[k,(b['candidate'][k]-a['candidate'][k]).fdiv(b['calls']-a['calls'])]}}}
end
bad=slopes.select{|x|%w[requests bytes].any?{|k|x[:candidate][k]>x[:baseline][k]}}
target=slopes.select{|x|x[:group][3]=='once'&&x[:calls]==[16,32]}.group_by{|x|x[:group].values_at(0,1,4)}.map do |g,rows|
 small,large=rows.sort_by{|x|x[:group][2]}
 raise 'Width set' unless [small[:group][2],large[:group][2]]==[64,2048]
 {group:g,rows:rows,flat:small[:candidate]==large[:candidate],preserved:large[:candidate]['bytes']<=large[:baseline]['bytes']}
end
raise 'Target coverage' unless target.size==18
v={status:regressions.empty?&&bad.empty?&&target.all?{|x|x[:flat]&&x[:preserved]} ? 'passed' : 'rejected',pairs:288,semantics:432,total_regressions:regressions,slope_regressions:bad,targets:target,slopes:slopes,report_sha256:sha.call(o+'/batch-controls/report.json'),verifier_sha256:sha.call(__FILE__)}
File.write(o+'/batch-verified.json',JSON.pretty_generate(v)+"\n")
raise "Rejected: #{regressions.size} totals / #{bad.size} slopes / targets=#{target.count{|x|x[:flat]&&x[:preserved]}}" unless v[:status]=='passed'
puts '288 batch comparisons/432 semantic checks passed; all18 hot batch groups flat and preserved'

verify-boundary.rb.text:

raise 'Boundary incomplete' unless r['status']=='passed'
raise 'Runner drift' unless r['runner_sha256']==Digest::SHA256.file('benchmarks/langarena/probes/dictionary-many-boundary-controls.rb').hexdigest
r['identities'].each{|p,h|raise 'Artifact drift' unless Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest==h}
keys=%w[bytes other_root].product([3,2048],[16,32])
raise 'Rows coverage' unless r['rows'].map{|x|x.values_at('pattern','width','calls','mode')}.sort==keys.flat_map{|x|%w[vm jit].map{|m|x+[m]}}.sort
raise 'Semantic coverage' unless r['semantics'].map{|x|x.values_at('pattern','width','calls','mode')}.sort==keys.flat_map{|x|%w[vm interpreter jit].map{|m|x+[m]}}.sort && r['semantics'].all?{|x|x['exit']==0}
r['rows'].each do |x|
 folder=d+'/'+out+'/'+x.values_at('pattern','width','calls').join('-')
 raise 'Fixture drift' unless Digest::SHA256.file(folder+'/main.kujo').hexdigest==x['source_sha256'] && Digest::SHA256.file(folder+'/owner.kujo').hexdigest==x['module_sha256']
 raise 'Total regression' unless %w[requests bytes].all?{|m|x['candidate'][m]<=x['baseline'][m]}
end
r['rows'].group_by{|x|x.values_at('pattern','width','mode')}.each do |_,rows|
 a,b=rows.sort_by{|x|x['calls']};raise 'Slope regression' unless %w[requests bytes].all?{|m|b['candidate'][m]-a['candidate'][m]<=b['baseline'][m]-a['baseline'][m]}
end

verify-broad.rb.text:
require 'json';require 'digest'
o=File.expand_path(__dir__);sha=->(p){Digest::SHA256.file(p).hexdigest};read=->(p){JSON.parse(File.read(o+'/'+p))}
raise 'Covered gates incomplete' unless read.call('continuation-state.json')['status']=='review-pending'
raise 'Source drift' unless system('ruby',o+'/verify-source.rb')
# Match every prior test by name and status, not just a success substring.
tests=->(p){a=File.read(p).scan(/^test (\S+) \.\.\. (ok|ignored[^\n]*)$/);raise 'Duplicate test names' unless a.map(&:first).uniq.size==a.size;a.to_h}
previous=tests.call(File.expand_path('../array-batch-v2-2026-10-29/library-tests.log',o))
extra=%w[interpreter::capture_independence::sparse_region_tests::sparse_region_rechecks_captured_scalar_types_without_caching_values]
current=tests.call(o+'/library-tests.log');raise 'Library test set/status drift' unless current==previous.merge(extra.to_h{|n|[n,'ok']})
raise 'Library result' unless File.read(o+'/library-tests.log').include?('1262 passed; 0 failed; 8 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out;')
prior_integration=tests.call(File.expand_path('../array-batch-v2-2026-10-29/integration-tests.log',o));raise 'Integration set/status' unless tests.call(o+'/integration-tests.log')==prior_integration.merge('captured_scalar_publication::captured_scalar_updates_preserve_dynamic_operators_and_partial_writes_on_error'=>'ok')
raise 'Integration result' unless File.read(o+'/integration-tests.log').include?('412 passed; 0 failed; 1 ignored; 0 measured; 0 filtered out;')
i=read.call('integration-build-state.json');b=read.call('build-state.json')
raise 'Integration identity' unless i['status']=='passed'&&i['library_sha256']==b['library_sha256']&&i['binary_sha256']==sha.call(o+'/integration-harness')&&i['harness_sha256']==sha.call(o+'/integration-harness.rs')&&i['flags_sha256']==sha.call(o+'/current-link-flags.json')
i.fetch('test_sources').each{|p,h|raise 'Integration source drift '+p unless sha.call(p)==h}
reference=JSON.parse(File.read('benchmarks/langarena/test.json')).sort_by{|x|x['name']};raise 'Corpus cardinality' unless reference.size==50&&reference.map{|x|x['name']}.uniq.size==50
raise 'Checksums incomplete' unless read.call('checksum-state.json')['status']=='passed'
%w[vm interpreter jit].each do |mode|
 r=read.call('all50-'+mode+'.json');raise 'Runtime identity' unless r['runtime']==mode&&r['binary']==o+'/candidate-kujo'
 raise 'Configuration set' unless r['results'].map{|x|x['config']}.sort_by{|x|x['name']}==reference
 r['results'].each do |x|
  raise 'Checksum row failure' unless x['status']=='passed'&&x['exitcode']==0&&x['runtime']==mode&&x['name']==x['config']['name']&&!x['stdout_truncated']&&!x['stderr_truncated']
  lines=x['stdout'].lines.map(&:chomp)
  raise 'Exact checksum output' unless lines.count(x['name']+': OK '+x['config']['checksum'].to_s)==1 && lines.count('Summary: 1, 1, 0')==1
